subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should compaction adopt the same aborted assistant tool-call drop policy already used by prompt-send replay, instead of synthesizing an error toolResult for aborted turns?
rationale: Both options produce provider-valid transcripts, but they encode different session-state semantics: drop avoids fabricated tool output while losing partial aborted-turn context, and synthesize preserves more transcript shape while adding invented result content.

options.title: Accept drop policy
options.body: Merge this PR after base refresh and own the small context-loss tradeoff as the canonical recovery behavior for aborted compaction tool-use turns.

options.title: Require synthetic result policy
options.body: Ask for a revision that keeps aborted tool-call turns provider-valid by inserting explicit synthetic error results instead of dropping the turn.

options.title: Pause for richer recovery design
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers define a broader synthetic-result or retry model for interrupted tool calls across replay and compaction.

recommendation.title: Accept drop policy
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after base refresh and own the small context-loss tradeoff as the canonical recovery behavior for aborted compaction tool-use turns.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest shared transcript repair history among the likely owners and is the best fit for the drop-versus-synthesize policy choice.
